issues.legal_issue: A killing committed to secure an unlawful assembly’s common object of forcibly taking possession is attributable to its members when it is immediately connected with that object.
material_facts: The group went armed to take forcible possession of land in another group’s cultivating possession.
When the occupants arrived and objected, the group gathered, threatened to finish them if they did not leave, and one member shot an occupant after he refused to go.
issues.conclusion: The killing was immediately connected with the common object of forcibly taking possession and was committed in prosecution of that object, bringing the members within the first part of section 149 of the Indian Penal Code.
issues.legal_principle: Under the first part of section 149 of the Indian Penal Code, the offence must be committed with a view to accomplishing the common object and must be immediately connected with it. The common object need not have been agreed at a prior meeting if it was adopted and shared by the members. The Court discussed Queen v. Sabid Ali (1873) 20 W.R. 5 Cr. in explaining the connection required between the offence and the common object.

rule.if: unlawful_assembly_prosecution and shared_forcible_possession_object and (armed_resistance_expected or threats_used_to_enforce_object) and killing_immediately_connected_to_object

predicates.unlawful_assembly_prosecution: The proceeding concerns members of an unlawful assembly prosecuted for a killing committed by one of its members.
predicates.shared_forcible_possession_object: The members shared the object of forcibly taking possession of property held by others.
predicates.armed_resistance_expected: The members went armed to take possession in circumstances in which they expected resistance.
predicates.threats_used_to_enforce_object: The members threatened those resisting their action to make them leave.
predicates.killing_immediately_connected_to_object: A member killed a person who resisted the assembly while it was carrying out its common object.

issues.definition: When members of an unlawful assembly share an object of forcible possession, anticipate resistance or use threats to overcome it, and a killing is immediately connected to carrying out that object, the killing is attributable to the assembly members as committed to advance the object.

issues.legal_issue: Members of an unlawful assembly are liable for an offence not directly committed to advance its common object when they knew that the offence was likely to be committed in its prosecution, rather than merely that it was possible.
material_facts: The members went to take forcible possession of land occupied by others while armed with a spear, a pistol and lathis.
The members gathered when the occupants objected, threatened them, and a member fired the pistol when the occupants refused to leave.
The Court accepted the finding that the weapons and the members’ conduct showed that they knew murder was likely in accomplishing their object.
issues.conclusion: The facts also established liability under the second part of section 149 because the members knew murder was likely to be committed in prosecution of their common object.
issues.legal_principle: The second part of section 149 of the Indian Penal Code applies where members knew that the offence was likely to be committed in prosecution of the common object; “know” does not mean awareness of a mere possibility. The Court referred to Queen v. Sabid Ali (1873) 20 W.R. 5 Cr. and Chikkarange Gowde v. State of Mysore, A.I.R. 1956 S.C. 731, distinguishing the latter on its findings and the defects in its charge.

rule.if: unlawful_assembly_prosecution and shared_common_object and killing_not_directly_required_for_object and (lethal_weapons_carried or threatening_conduct_used) and circumstances_show_members_knew_killing_likely

predicates.unlawful_assembly_prosecution: The proceeding concerns members of an unlawful assembly prosecuted for a killing by one of its members.
predicates.shared_common_object: The members shared the object being pursued by the assembly.
predicates.killing_not_directly_required_for_object: The killing was not itself shown to be a direct requirement of the assembly’s object.
predicates.lethal_weapons_carried: Members carried weapons capable of causing death while pursuing the common object.
predicates.threatening_conduct_used: The members used threats or other conduct showing their readiness to use force to accomplish the common object.
predicates.circumstances_show_members_knew_killing_: The weapons and conduct, considered in the circumstances, showed that the members knew a killing was likely in pursuing the common object.

issues.definition: If members of an unlawful assembly share an object, carry lethal weapons or use threatening conduct, and the circumstances show they knew a killing was likely in pursuing that object, they are liable for the killing even if it was not directly required by the object.

issues.legal_issue: A death sentence is not mitigated merely because the person who intentionally used a weapon to advance the common object did so at a parent’s instruction.
material_facts: The accused carried a pistol from home as a member of a group pursuing forcible possession of land.
He used the pistol to kill a person resisting the group after his father told him to fire.
issues.conclusion: The Court held that acting at his father’s instance was not a mitigating circumstance and upheld the death sentence.
issues.legal_principle: The Court held that the accused shared the assembly’s common object, carried the pistol to use it in pursuing that object, and used it; the fact that he acted at his father’s instance did not mitigate the sentence. No statutory provision or earlier case was relied on for this sentencing conclusion.

rule.if: capital_sentence_review and person_shared_common_object and person_carried_weapon_to_advance_object and person_used_weapon_to_kill and person_acted_on_parent_instruction

predicates.capital_sentence_review: The proceeding reviews a death sentence imposed on a person convicted for a killing committed in the course of a group’s conduct.
predicates.person_shared_common_object: The person shared the group’s object being pursued when the killing occurred.
predicates.person_carried_weapon_to_advance_object: The person brought a weapon intending to use it in pursuing the group’s object.
predicates.person_used_weapon_to_kill: The person used the weapon to kill someone resisting the group.
predicates.person_acted_on_parent_instruction: The person used the weapon after a parent instructed them to do so.

issues.definition: When a person sharing a group’s object brings and uses a weapon to kill in pursuit of that object, acting on a parent’s instruction does not mitigate the death sentence.
